title: Exact five-term target row of the extended tensored cone
statement: Let ρ:A→C be a homomorphism of commutative rings in universe u, f:P1→P2 a chain map of integer-indexed A-module complexes, and N any C-module complex. Define tensorConeTriangle(ρ,f,N) by applying termwise extension along ρ and total tensor with N to the actual mappingCone(f) triangle. The five-term row H^i(T1)→H^i(T2)→H^i(T3)→H^(i+1)(T1)→H^(i+1)(T2), whose third arrow is CochainComplex.homologyδOfTriangle and whose other arrows are the indicated homology maps of T.mor1,T.mor2, is exact at all three interior terms. Neither ρ nor N nor the Pj need be flat or K-flat.

proof.text: Construct tensorConeTriangle as the composite mapTriangle functor applied to the actual cone triangle. CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapTriangleIso identifies scalar extension of this triangle with the cone of the extended f. The source-library map₂CochainComplexFlipObjMapMappingConeTriangleIso identifies its tensor with N with the cone of F(f) tensor N.

Choose HasDerivedCategory.standard locally only to use the homology API. The derived image of this concrete triangle is distinguished by the cone-triangle theorem and the displayed triangle isomorphism. Apply Mathlib CochainComplex.homologyMap_exact₂_of_distTriang, exact₃_of_distTriang and exact₁_of_distTriang. Assemble the three consecutive exact short complexes using ComposableArrows.exact_of_δ₀.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorConeTriangle_five_term_exact (i : ℤ) :
    let T := tensorConeTriangle ρ f N
    (ComposableArrows.mk₄ (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap T.mor₁ i)
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap T.mor₂ i)
      (CochainComplex.homologyδOfTriangle T i (i + 1))
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap T.mor₁ (i + 1))).Exact
